name: Core Foundation & Auto-Fix Engine
reconciliationNote: Phase 1 complete. P1-T008..P1-T015 were verified implemented in src/. P1-T016 (unit tests) resolved: the 11 previously-failing assertions were fixed at their source (AutoFixEngine context window contextBefore 3->2, success-rate denominator fixableIssues->totalIssues, addToHistory now caps history at 51; FileWatcher.matchPattern rewritten to handle the `**/` globstar as zero-or-more path segments with escaped regex specials; BuildMonitor generates buildId before CI detection and separates in-session history from persisted trend history). P1-T017 (integration tests) added at test/__tests__/integration.test.js with 5 offline end-to-end cases; while writing it a real cross-platform backup bug was found and fixed (createBackup joined an absolute path, which broke on Windows drive roots) via stripPathRoot() in auto-fix-engine.js and rule-based-fixer.js. Full suite: `node test/run.js` -> 78 passing / 0 failing.

pending.description: Write comprehensive tests for rule-based and AI fixers
pending.statusNote: Complete. All 11 previously-failing assertions fixed at their source rather than by weakening tests: AutoFixEngine (context window contextBefore 3->2; success-rate denominator fixableIssues->totalIssues; addToHistory caps history at 51), FileWatcher.matchPattern (rewritten globstar-aware tokenizer: `**/`->zero-or-more segments, `**`->any, `*`->non-separator, specials escaped), BuildMonitor (buildId generated before CI detection so Local env has a defined id; in-session history separated from persisted trend history so ambient .aqt-reports data no longer triggers first-build regressions). Suite now 73/73 unit tests passing under test/harness.js + test/run.js (`npm test`).

pending.name: Create integration tests
pending.description: Build end-to-end tests for analyze -> fix workflow
pending.statusNote: Complete. Added test/__tests__/integration.test.js with 5 offline, deterministic end-to-end cases run by the existing harness: (1) dry-run reports fixes without modifying the file; (2) real fix normalizes file content on disk via PatternFixer (CRLF->LF, trailing whitespace, blank-line collapse, space-after-comma); (3) backup + rollback restores the original file; (4) stats reflect a completed run; (5) unfixable issues surface as remaining. All I/O sandboxed under os.tmpdir(). While building the rollback case, found and fixed a real cross-platform bug: createBackup() joined an absolute source path (broke on Windows drive roots) — fixed with stripPathRoot() in auto-fix-engine.js and rule-based-fixer.js. Full suite `node test/run.js` -> 78 passing / 0 failing.
